children: Bruce Booth, Director, reported selling 792,190 shares of Kymera Therapeutics common stock for a total of $132,380,833. On Nov. 24, 2026, he reported sales through Atlas Venture Fund X, L.P. of 466,242 shares in six transactions at a weighted average price of $166.01, and through Atlas Venture Opportunity Fund I, L.P. of 91,369 shares in six transactions at a weighted average price of $166.00. On Nov. 25, he reported sales through Atlas Venture Fund X, L.P. of 119,058 shares in four transactions at a weighted average price of $173.17, and through Atlas Venture Opportunity Fund I, L.P. of 23,331 shares in four transactions at a weighted average price of $173.17. He also directly sold 92,190 shares in four transactions that day at a weighted average price of $164.39. Booth no longer directly owns Kymera Therapeutics common stock. He indirectly owns 1,799,385 shares through Atlas Venture Fund X, L.P. and 348,156 shares through Atlas Venture Opportunity Fund I, L.P.; he disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares held by each fund except to the extent of his pecuniary interest, if any.
